The game has potential; it's fun, and challenging But right now inputs are pretty bad. There are times when you go to a certain room and your character moves on their own in one direction, and it's hard to move out of that direction. I'd also like some quality of life change such as being able to read artifact descriptions when we're using the artifact and trying to decide on keeping it, selling it, or passing over it for better artifacts i'll change my recommendation if the input issue gets fixed; it's pretty bad right now for me at least

Review updated 4/1 post release of the game. This game CAN be quite fun and definitely has a ton of potential. But there are several issues I have with the game that lead me to be unable to recommend the game in its current state. Hopefully these can be fixed quickly as the game is otherwise incredibly fun with an interesting combination of progression systems. The permanent rune-stone progression system has the potential to be a very fun way of specializing certain characters to have the stats you want, however the lack of permanent storage besides the active stones means it is often better to either pick general stats, or only focus on one character. The spirit affinity system for relics means each run has an additional layer of build-crafting potential, with my only complain being that there doesn't seem to be a way to inspect the elemental status effects to see what they actually do. [h3]Issues I have with the game(I will update this section as more issues come up, and others are fixed):[/h3] 1. I was able to fix this issue by switching to a different controller, however the original controller did not have any issues in other games. The game has a ton of trouble with reading inputs. Movement, attacks, dodges, directional attacks, any button press has somewhere between 25-50% chance to simply do nothing. This makes boss fights and chaotic rooms where you're dodging 4-5 AoE attacks impossible to complete without taking damage. 2. THIS ISSUE HAS BEEN RESOLVED BY AN UPDATE. Enemy's not dying fully. Some enemies will die and still be target-able by certain relics and skills. This is very obvious on purple hair(I forgot her name XD) where you can see the arcane stacks hovering around a empty squares where enemies used to be. This was originally a minor annoyance, however it caused me to be unable to progress past the [spoiler]cultist [/spoiler] boss as there were 3 copies of the boss left alive despite there being no more health bar, and no way to damage them. 3. THIS ISSUE HAS BEEN RESOLVED BY AN UPDATE. The main quest? I have 2 quests that I discovered within 5 runs of starting the game. Both require me to talk to someone in the hub area. One NPC in the hub area says nothing when I talk to them. The other gives me the same dialogue each time with no progress. 4. New issue with full release of the game. On my first run post update I was able to inspect enough bodies to complete a note for an NPC. THIS COMPLETELY SOFTLOCKED MY RUN. The dialogue box went away and I was left without any HUD and unable to move my character or open any menus. Additionally the UI for inspecting dead bodies has not been fully adapted for controller inputs. There is no way to scroll up or down to read the entire entry, and the "A" prompt to close makes my character dodge. Quick note I have now had this bug occur 2 of the 3 times I completed a note set.

I really want to like this game. It's beautiful, interesting story so far, and it has the potential to actually be really fun. However, one MAJOR thing is holding it back and its the clunky movement, the inability to attack during movement, and the fact that you can't dodge through enemies with the dodge key. I would NOT recommend this game unless the devs will do something about the movement and overhaul it completely. Until then, the game is not worth playing at all.

我没法说自己会玩肉鸽但是稍微知道怎么样玩的舒服一点 运营的部分虽然相比以前好很多但是依旧太少了 比如黑血卵旁边的刺应该是对标卖血机一类的东西，但是掉17滴血才给十块钱有些抠搜了，一个血瓶在商店是卖两百吧没记错的话，角色前中期一般就150，200血，一瓶血瓶下去只回复70左右 除了自带血瓶之外能回血之外就只能靠运气看看清房间能不能出心什么的了，运气差的话就只有初始角色新月斩的四级分支能稳定回血（没暴击率遗物的话回的也特别少） 黑血除了上面提到的卖血之外靠打怪和敲铃铛，还有部分的遗物能额外产出，铃铛我一局能打过的话一般就见到一两个，额外产出遗物有但是不升级产出极少 房间中的障碍物打掉有奖励但是要跑过去打才行（一般是血量和蓝图），本来一局就接近一个小时了如果每个房间都要破坏完障碍物就太费时间了，直接把原本在障碍物的掉落物给到清理房间奖励更好些 每次到新的一章之前的那个房间是随机的有点难以理解，如果我技能满了又遇到一个书房真的会很生气 作为稳定提升的遗物虫也是非常看运气出（甚至商店不卖），一局平均就两三个，还平均分布在全局，好不容易在开局找到一个有成长能力的遗物半天找不到遗物虫，个人觉得给到boss房固定额外掉落一个比较好，明明有那么多有说法的遗物需要升级但是却要因为运气差而一直励志（毕竟百分之80的遗物最低级状态给的属性全是蚊子腿） 作为可以运营的物资来说，钥匙实在是太多了，虽然考虑到只要不开宝箱就完全没有提升这件事钥匙给多一点没什么问题，不过这样就显得钥匙意义不明了，建议加强宝箱房然后降低钥匙掉率 精灵联合意义不明，哪怕真的能打出comb也是加的属性增幅遗物的，但它本身占用的已经是遗物的拿取了，建议和遗物拆开来放 宝石，我在刷什么圣遗物吗，还是打完就全部到只剩五个以至于我没法对特定角色换特定配置的那种，真的，副词条删了吧，什么宝石就光加什么属性，也别有数值波动，局内的宝石可以留到营地但是营地的只能带五个不就好了 最最最幽默的（抱歉但是真的很难绷得住），那个药水，为什么是随机提升或降低两个属性，哪怕光是必定正收益的随机提升都很抽象了（参考以撒的黄针），甚至还有升级版大幅提升或降低两个属性，这俩药水甚至要我花钱买（你知道我不小心点到的时候减了我百分之五的暴击率和连击率的时候有多想笑吗） 类似的还有女武神雕像的第三个选项，消耗一个技能点提升随机属性，先不说随机提升加到不想要的属性上不就纯浪费一点了，技能点这种东西一升级就直接用掉了，升级之后不直接的话输出会差一截 角色还有操作什么的 上面也说了只有初始角色有稳定回血手端，其他角色对我来说实在想不到怎么打过高难度，更何况其他角色的aoe攻击不然就范围小不然就难触发，清理小怪的时候真的非常难受 还有打boss的时候的倒计时是干什么的，红的看起来像是倒计时结束就会把我秒了之类的（还没触发过不知道） 闪避改成能穿过敌人确实非常舒服，不过空格特技的突刺攻击作用没看出来有多少，我反而觉得以前的按住方向键攻击默认突刺好些 房间和boss太少了 不是说一局下来清理的房间数量少，是说房间的种类太少了，基本就是同样的方形房间当中多出几个障碍物和机关（机关也非常单一）而且房间能交互的部分也非常少，可以的话最好是出怪绑定房间，像是以撒那样（工作量应该很大，而且要动很多代码吧，问题不大没精力不改也行） 单个boss质量都很高，不过打多了还是会审美疲劳，加些轮换的会好些 如果被画风吸引到就非常推荐，本身也非常有潜力，感觉可以一直升值） （画风真的超大杯吧）

作为一款肉鸽游戏 1，它的运营空间几乎为零， 难度高一点就全看运气了，擅长思考与决策的跟不擅长的拉不开差距 你知道这两点加起来意味着什么吗？ 意味着即使你是游戏老手，经验丰富，打难度高的局该难受照样难受 你也可以不打难度高的局，但作者会锁后续剧情和局外养成， 不打通最高难度就别想看到结局！！！ 2，它的肉鸽只是简单的数值提升 什么构筑，什么组合comb，几乎没有，就算有也极难遇到， 它宣传一百多个遗物，但绝大多数都是简单的数值提升，毫无肉鸽游戏的魅力 3，它的商店很不稳定 商店只卖两类货，一类是基础掉落物，一类是遗物，但它卖哪一类是完全随机的， 你知道我连着四个大层，商店只卖基础掉落物，零提升， 然后带着能买七八个遗物的钱去打最终boss是一种怎样的心情吗 作为一款走格子游戏 1，它不能够通过位移穿越怪物 你可能不知道这意味着什么， 当你面对怪群的包围时，你的位移空间是很少的，因为怪物背后的空间你是过不去的 再加上不少地图设有障碍和墙体，使得你只有两三格宽的通道，对面又走来了两只怪， 被堵墙角，被卡位置，被围殴都是常有的事，真的极其让人恼火 2，容易被自己的普攻卡在原地， 即打怪时看到红光预警，想位移走开时角色还在执行普攻的动作，然后呆在原地吃伤害了 还有各种各样的bug 1，怪物和boss在现身和瞬身位移后，有较长的无敌帧 我不知道作者是不是故意的，这个无敌帧时间真的有蛮长， 怪物现身后都有预备攻击的抬手动作了，我打它还是不跳伤害数字 boss都从天而降落地了，落地的冲击波都跑了两三格了，都有下一个攻击的预警了， 还是处在无敌状态，(这里点名第二远征队长和大蜘蛛) 这种无敌帧很容易吞玩家的伤害，尤其是多动症怪和高难度更高攻击欲望和速度的boss(说的就是你，第二远征队长) 2，地图界面传送时，按“往下”键时会关闭地图并使玩家移动， 此bug能非常稳定地触发，有多稳定呢，我十几个小时传送近百次，就两次没给我把地图界面关闭掉 这导致地图传送的体验非常差，很多时我宁愿多跑几步路都不愿意开传送被恶心一次 3，各种各样的卡关， 我遇到的是，雷精灵有个技能是冲刺释放电圈，射程挺长 然后我在进下一个房间的时候，习惯性冲刺跑图，然后电圈好像提前打碎了房间里什么东西， 于是就卡关了，该房间不刷怪，且不打开通往其他房间的门 4，可破坏物无法正常破坏 一个遗物，是一座熊雕像，会在房间随机位置生成，视为墙体， 如果它恰好刷在房间中央，也就是掉落物生成的地方，而你在清怪时没把它打掉， 那恭喜你，这房间给的奖励你拿不到了，它跟雕像的模型重合在一起， 而那个雕像在你去清别的房间，去把这一层都清完了，也不会消失 反正我是破防了，上述这些问题都挺影响游戏体验， 在作者把该修的，该调整的弄完之前，我不推荐购买此游戏

For the most part I've enjoyed the game, but that was before the untested buggy updates made the experience worse. Obvious Qol features not implemented. Broken audio. Unbalanced characters and their skill trees. Game breaking artifacts right next to artifacts that do literal nothing. Small dev team picked a genius strategy: to take on every possible task with every ongoing project. Maintaining two games and making a new game all at once.

I'm struggling to find a game to compare this to (maybe one step through eden), but the real-time grid-based combat works really well here. The boss fights are among some of the best I've come across. If it seems slow in the beginning, give it until the final difficulty, where the speed ramps up and you're able to unlock the true ending. There are some gripes I have: no mouse support, unable to click through some dialogues, and certain keys are hard bound overlapping with remapped keys ("f" to interact). But none of it conflicts with the combat, which I have to say again, is really good.

I really enjoy playing Guides Zero! The pixel art looks amazing, the music fits the atmosphere perfectly, and the story is very engaging. I hope in future updates you can consider adding: New playable classes, for example an Archer class with long-range skills and unique skill trees. More character variety, maybe classes with different playstyles like summoner, assassin, or support. New dungeons with completely different themes, enemies, and storylines to expand the world. More branching paths or random events to make each run feel even more unique and unpredictable. Overall, this game has huge potential as a roguelike. I’m excited to see how it grows in future updates. Keep up the great work!

If you enjoyed a hybrid of 2D top-down Legend of Zelda dungeon delving with the Enter the Gungeon bullet-hell style of dungeon delving, then this game is for you. This is a highly enjoyable rogue-lite dungeon delving game, with quests, unlockable playable characters, lots of intriguing loot and playstyles, and a messload of cool secrets. Very enjoyable for people who like this genre. Easy to learn, takes a while to master, but very fun.

Insanely fun and well polished roguelike game. Huge variety of ways to min-max your character. Easily find an OP build and then you die because you get too cocky. Then the next round you find an even more OP build. However this doesn't mean the game is easy - higher difficulties and new bosses unlock as you progress, which keeps the game challenging throughout your playthrough. The story is catchy and it unfolds as you explore the depths. On top of that you get to play as a pixel anime waifu. Highly recommended.

It was decently fun at start but the game becomes stale pretty quick. The item's don't add much variety to the gameplay. During progress, you're supposed to increase the difficulty which does some stuff + makes enemies healthier. Everything is a non issue except the health. It can be a real chore to push through because (for me) it was not uncommon to go through an entire run without any form of real damage upgrade. There are potions that either increase or decrease 2 stats that in my experience is never worth taking. Stat boost is nice, but a stat decrease can be a nightmare considering how little stat gain the game offers you in the first place. PROS: - The combat is fun, the combination of grid based and real-time is unique and the player feedback (visual/sound effects) makes fighting very satisfying. - The pixel art, animation and VFX are gorgeous, the game is an absolute pleasure to look at. - The boss fights are fair and well designed. - The difficulty curve is solid overall* - The available characters all seem viable and have unique playstyles. CONS: - Most of the progression systems, both inside and outside the run are just stat increases. They don't actually change the way you want to play or enable interesting builds/synergies. - Some of the mutually exclusive upgrades on the skill tree actively synergize with each other, which seems like an odd design decision to me. - Story content is locked behind the increased difficulty modes. - *Except the highest difficulty is imo frustratingly difficult and not worth playing. The jump from Eclipse to Total Eclipse is disproportionate and requires A LOT of skill and stars to align to reasonably complete. Overall I do think it's worth playing, especially on sale. It's very enjoyable for the first 10 hours or so, just don't expect the kind of replayability you'd see in top roguelites like Slay the Spire and Hades. The playstyles really just stem from the characters and their skill trees, not the artifacts, so there's not enough incentive to keep playing once you've done a couple of runs on each character. Don't bother with 100% completion unless you're either really good or really masochistic. 7/10

A very charming game, although it suffers a little bit from not enough information being explained and being rather unfair a lot of the time. Gameplay wise, I had a lot of fun all the way through, with the whole grid-system being quite engaging. Most bosses were very fun to learn the patterns for, and some are easily baitable to do specific attacks that might be more convenient to dodge or abuse for damage. The story is okay, typical fantasy "save the world from evil forces lurking in the depths" going on here. It gets the job done. Endings being gated behind harder difficulties is quite an odd choice though. While it may be manageable on the easier ones, Eclipse and Total Eclipse are a huge jump in difficulty (those alone took more than half of my total playtime to do). Enemies get so condensed on the harder difficulties that it becomes basically impossible to avoid damage, on top of some enemies teleporting right into attacking range out of player reach or moving away from you before attacking. They do a lot more damage as well, even with damage reduction (yay!!!!!!). Also, said enemies become faster than normal, meaning they can easily overwhelm you unless you have a way of quickly clearing the room while avoiding most of the madness that is currently happening. Artifacts are very hit or miss. A few are run defining, most seemingly do minimal stat changes, some outright ruin the run, and some do nothing at all or are completely insignificant other than activating spirit powers. Funnily enough, getting flat ATK is a lot better than ATK% since the player has so little ATK to begin with it barely grows, and most artifacts give ATK%. Making builds is basically a no-go. Each playable character gets 2 different abilities to choose from before starting a run, and all of it's performance comes from leveling up and spending trait points to upgrade them. Stat boosts barely do anything to them, although a few artifacts can form synergies (and some can straight up make it unusable). Rooms are very predictable, since from what I've experienced they are not procedurally generated, but preset layouts that get picked at random. I've seen identical floor layouts more than once in my playthroughs, but that allows run optimization for speedruns and whatnot, so I'm not that against it. Getting the achievements is a breeze considering you will get all of them before getting the good ending, and I really like that. I'd love to see this more often in more games, because hunting collectibles is just not fun at all. One glaring problem this game has is that it has no documentation about it anywhere, no dedicated wiki, nothing. This means that you will need to figure stuff out yourself as you play. There might be stuff on the official Discord for the game but I never bothered checking, nor do I care. Also one texture is broken half the time, not that it affects the gameplay but it's quite funny. While this game has quite a few flaws, I'd say this is worth playing. I enjoyed the time i had with this game.
